title: Website Purpose and Information Architecture
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting website purpose and information architecture to GitHub Pages file tree with accessibility, privacy, and publishing checks, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Write a one-sentence purpose statement ([audience] + [single job]) and use it to rank candidate pages
Apply the task, reach, and empty checks to keep, promote, or cut each candidate page within the click budget
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
